canonical_json.units: resolve and normalize before identity construction
canonical_json.timestamps_output_directories_and_tempor: exclude from scientific identity; retain separately as operational provenance
canonical_json.file_identity: identify content by logical role, byte length and SHA-256, never by a private absolute path alone

contract_versioning.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes of a domain-separated prefix and canonical JSON; each identity family has its own prefix and version.

method_aware_maturity.resolution: Exact registered composite scope only; no fallback from method to analysis type, nearest method, or broad legacy registry entry.

qualification_scope.scope_id: Deterministic identifier derived from the exact resolved scope tuple; each tuple has its own qualification authority and evidence links.
qualification_scope.decision_rule: No axis is inferred from another. A numerical PASS is evidence for review, not a qualification decision or maturity transition.

physical_identity.purpose: Identify the modeled physical system independently of the solver method and applied excitation.
required_components: geometry coordinates and geometry content identity
element connectivity, family and formulation/integration identifiers
material model identifiers, parameters, units and initial physical state when relevant
boundary conditions, prescribed values, constraint semantics and constrained DOF map
active DOF set, physical DOF labels and stable DOF ordering map
concentrated mass entities including stable ID, node, DOF mapping, mass/inertia values and units
spring entities including stable ID, endpoints/support ownership, DOFs, stiffness values and units
resolved unit system and coordinate/frame conventions
model schema and physical semantic version
physical_identity.discrete_entity_rule: Concentrated masses and springs are first-class physical inputs; omission of either from identity is invalid.
physical_identity.legacy_identity_use: An identity missing required physical components is incomplete and cannot authorize cache reuse or checkpoint resume.

operator_identity.purpose: Identify assembled/prepared operators and constraints so they can be reused when excitation alone changes.
required_components: physical_identity digest
source commit and relevant assembly implementation identity
operator family and formulation versions
full/reduced DOF maps and reduction/projection identity
M and K content digests where assembled, including discrete mass and spring contributions
declared damping operator identity when a physical damping operator exists
assembly options and unit-resolved parameters
operator_identity.reuse_rule: K/M may be reused only if the complete operator identity matches. An excitation change alone does not invalidate K/M; a physical or assembly change does.

excitation_identity.purpose: Identify spatial load distributions and their temporal amplitudes independently of K/M.
required_components: stable unique channel IDs
real spatial distribution keyed by physical DOF or a hashed external load field
resolved spatial units, coordinate frame and sign convention
temporal amplitude or complex phasor, input units and resolved values
frequency/history samples, ordering and content digest when applicable
phase convention and load-factor application policy
excitation_identity.canonical_order: Sort channels by stable channel ID; preserve the semantic sample order inside each history.
excitation_identity.zero_channel: Accept as a recorded no-op. It contributes zero force and remains in input provenance/identity; it must not trigger a nonzero response claim.
excitation_identity.cancellation: Combine channels deterministically in canonical ID order; retain per-channel provenance and record the resulting net excitation.
excitation_identity.load_factor: Apply each declared load factor exactly once at the defined channel-composition stage.
excitation_identity.contradictory_syntax: If legacy load syntax and new channel syntax are both present, accept only proven semantic equivalence or an explicit, versioned disjoint-channel combine mode. Otherwise reject; never silently add, override or double-apply either representation.

modal_basis_identity.purpose: Bind basis vectors and spectral selection to the exact operator and extraction contract.
required_components: operator identity digest
eigensolver/backend and relevant version/configuration
basis dimension and physical/reduced DOF map
eigenvalue ordering and selected spectral interval/count
normalization and mass-matrix digest
basis content digest
cluster membership and cluster-policy version
truncation-policy version
modal_basis_identity.invalidation: Any physical/operator/constraint/M/K change, basis data change or relevant extraction-policy change invalidates the basis for reuse.
modal_basis_identity.normalization: For a real symmetric basis, Phi.T M_r Phi = I within a preregistered method tolerance; complex generalizations must use the contracted Hermitian form.
modal_basis_identity.sign_phase: Individual real signs or complex phases are nonphysical; comparisons and identity decisions use canonical data/subspace rules, not raw sign/phase equality.
modal_basis_identity.clusters: Record clusters as subspaces using a versioned, preregistered spectral-gap policy. A requested truncation that cuts an identified cluster is REJECT_EXPLICITLY; no silent mode-count expansion.
modal_basis_identity.cluster_threshold_policy: The detection formula and tolerance source must be fixed by the method contract before benchmark results; missing policy or threshold is a fail-closed precondition.

execution_identity.purpose: Identify one numerical execution and the result semantics it produces.
required_components: source commit and solver implementation identity
physical identity digest
operator identity digest
excitation identity digest or explicit NONE
modal basis identity digest or explicit NONE
damping identity and model semantics
initial conditions and their frame
integration/frequency grid and numerical algorithm settings
tolerances, result request and result-schema/semantic versions
relevant dependency versions and numerical environment
execution_identity.key: SHA-256 of the canonical, domain-separated identity document.
execution_identity.change_rule: Any scientifically relevant component change creates a different execution identity; operational-only metadata does not.

resume_required_bindings: supported checkpoint schema and semantic version
physical identity including concentrated masses and springs
operator identity including constraints, M/K and damping semantics
excitation identity when the execution depends on applied channels
execution identity including algorithm, time step/grid, tolerances and initial state
accepted solver state and all required state/result artifact hashes
safe_resume_conditions: schema is explicitly supported or a named, reviewed adapter proves semantic equivalence
all required identity digests match the current model and execution
all required state fields and artifacts exist and verify by size/hash
migration is lossless for required state and preserves its meaning
no unknown field or semantic ambiguity affects continuation
checkpoint_and_migration.read_policy: An old record may be decoded read-only for inspection while being explicitly marked non-resumable.
checkpoint_and_migration.migration_policy: Never rewrite historical checkpoint bytes or synthesize missing physical identity. Store any reviewed migrated representation separately with source hash, adapter ID and provenance.
checkpoint_and_migration.newmark_identity_requirement: A Newmark checkpoint must bind mass/spring-inclusive physical identity, operator identity, excitation, damping, initial conditions, integration step and state.

models.definition: C = alpha M + beta K; when reduced, C_r = P.T C P using the same full operators and projection, or an explicitly declared reduced-operator construction.
models.physical_matrix_claim: Allowed only when the construction actually defines the physical full-space C and its projection. A reduced-only approximation must be labelled reduced.

models.definition: C_modal = diag(2*zeta_j*omega_j) in the selected, identified modal basis.
models.physical_matrix_claim: Not a complete physical full-space C by default; never fabricate one solely to export reactions.
models.degenerate_cluster_rule: Within an exact or policy-defined near-degenerate cluster, damping must be invariant to basis rotation: use equal damping over the cluster or a separately contracted invariant cluster operator. Otherwise reject the assignment.

damping_semantics.direct_reduced_equivalence: Assert equivalence only when M/K/constraints, damping operator, excitation, initial conditions, retained basis and numerical scheme are demonstrably equivalent. A modal damping diagonal is not assumed equivalent to a physical direct damping matrix.
damping_semantics.reaction_implication: Physical reactions require all physical terms used in the full-space equilibrium balance. Reduced modal damping alone does not satisfy this condition.

modal_basis_contract.system_binding: Exact operator identity, full/reduced DOF maps, M/K digests, constraint reduction and basis extraction version.
modal_basis_contract.dimensions: Record full system dimension, reduced dimension, basis column count and retained cluster boundaries.
modal_basis_contract.normalization: Declare M-orthonormality target and measured residual; no implicit renormalization after identity is established.
modal_basis_contract.ordering: Deterministic sort by contracted eigenvalue key with stable tie handling; clusters treated as subspaces.
modal_basis_contract.truncation: If requested count cuts a detected cluster, reject explicitly. Do not silently include extra modes or separate a cluster.
modal_basis_contract.model_mutation: Any relevant identity change invalidates the basis and dependent caches.

harmonic.conversion: omega = 2*pi*f exactly once at the explicit input boundary

excitation_contract.force_zero_and_cancellation: Zero channels are accepted as recorded no-ops; cancellation is deterministic and per-channel provenance is retained.
excitation_contract.legacy_compatibility: Existing load syntax and defaults continue unchanged when the new channel syntax is absent. Mixed syntax must be equivalent or use a future explicit disjoint combine mode; ambiguity is rejected.
excitation_contract.factor_application: Load and scaling factors are applied once at the contract-defined composition stage; duplicate application is invalid.
excitation_contract.scope_guard: Do not convert all historical loads into complex-valued entities. Only temporal harmonic amplitudes use complex phasors.

response_frames_and_base_motion.coordinate_map: P maps reduced relative coordinates into the full physical DOF vector; r_full is the influence vector for the declared uniform translational base direction.
response_frames_and_base_motion.mass_ordering: Construct the base-inertia term with the complete supported M_full before elimination of constrained DOFs whenever coupling requires it; then project consistently.
response_frames_and_base_motion.influence_vector: For uniform translational base motion, translational DOFs follow the declared direction and rotational entries are zero. The DOF map and coordinate frame are explicit.
response_frames_and_base_motion.moving_supports: Only supports declared comoving with the prescribed base and consistent with the influence map are admissible. Incompatible independently prescribed support motion is rejected.
response_frames_and_base_motion.springs: Spring endpoints/support motion ownership is explicit; no spring-to-ground motion is inferred from a fixed-support label.

input_availability.base_acceleration_given: Relative response and absolute acceleration can be reported when the solver response exists and the map is known.
input_availability.base_displacement_or_velocity: Absolute displacement/velocity require x_g/v_g history or declared integration constants/initial conditions; otherwise mark unavailable, not zero.

reaction_availability.available_when: A contracted full-space equilibrium balance can be reconstructed from known physical M, K, physical C if applicable, excitation, constraints and response fields.
unavailable_when: only prescribed modal damping exists and no equivalent physical full-space C is defined
required constrained/full-space state is not retained or reconstructible
base-motion/support coupling needed by equilibrium is missing
reaction_availability.not_computed: Reaction calculation was supported and requested by the method but was not performed.
reaction_availability.not_applicable: The selected analysis/result contract has no reaction quantity.
reaction_availability.forbidden: Never synthesize a physical C or report zero reactions to disguise unavailable data.

per_quantity_fields: relative or absolute frame when applicable
result_availability.export_rule: An unavailable, unretained and unreconstructible quantity cannot be emitted as an empty table or zero-filled result. An export request must return an explicit typed error/status with reason.
result_availability.stress_rule: Stress export is only available when its measure, configuration/frame, semantic version and recovery path are declared; no dynamic stress snapshot capability is implied by this contract.

serialization_and_semantic_versioning.typed_result_required: Serialize through explicit DTO/serializer contracts; do not serialize PreparedDynamicSystem, ModalBasis or other runtime Python objects directly into model JSON.
serialization_and_semantic_versioning.complex_values: Represent as explicit {real, imag} finite scalars; never cast silently to real.
serialization_and_semantic_versioning.legacy_reading: Keep historical serializers/readers available where possible. A decoder may return a read-only legacy view annotated with its original schema and known semantic gaps.
serialization_and_semantic_versioning.semantic_change: OLD_SEMANTICS != NEW_SEMANTICS. New labels/versioned fields do not retroactively reinterpret stored values.
serialization_and_semantic_versioning.legacy_second_piola_rule: A legacy field named second_piola_stress is not proof that its bytes contain second Piola stress. Preserve its old payload/label as legacy, mark unresolved semantics, and never silently relabel or transform it.
serialization_and_semantic_versioning.old_result_migration: Read-only adapter unless a separate versioned, lossless semantic migration is authorized and tested; never edit historical evidence in place.

stress_semantics.local_stress: Must state both the actual stress measure and the element/local frame; 'local' alone is not a constitutive measure.
stress_semantics.first_piola: Two-point stress measure mapping reference area to force; frame/configuration must be recorded.
stress_semantics.second_piola: Reference-configuration material stress measure; only emitted when the computed tensor has this meaning.
stress_semantics.cauchy: Current-configuration true stress; identify the transformation/recovery path and current frame.

tangent_provenance_fields: raw finite-difference tangent before any symmetrization
returned tangent actually consumed by Newton iteration
finite-difference step policy and characteristic length
force evaluation count and perturbation ordering
raw/returned tangent asymmetry and comparison metrics
nonlinear_contract_boundaries.wp08_wp09_rescope_rule: If a correction requires a substantial new constitutive formulation, finite-strain plasticity, multiplicative plasticity, or a general corotational continuum reformulation: STOP, RECORD_LIMITATION, RESCOPE_REQUIRED. No silent 0.2.12 scope expansion.
nonlinear_contract_boundaries.wp01_effect: Define semantics and required evidence only; no constitutive, tangent or result-producing behavior changes in WP01.

api_and_backward_compatibility.unsupported_new_method_scope: Reject only that new route with a typed fail-closed reason; do not globally reject a model accepted by an existing compatible route.
api_and_backward_compatibility.model_serialization: PreparedDynamicSystem and ModalBasis are runtime objects and are not embedded directly in JSON model input.
api_and_backward_compatibility.legacy_checkpoint_and_result_reading: Preserve supported reading; safe resume and semantic reinterpretation are separate decisions.

wp01_contract_tests.test_kind: Declarative contract tests only; no future solver, operator assembly, excitation, constitutive update or time integration is executed.
required_cases: unknown method scope rejects with no maturity fallback
new method target is EXPERIMENTAL and numerical PASS does not imply qualification
direct and reduced harmonic/transient scopes have distinct qualification IDs
unavailable result has an explicit status and reason
legacy serialization read policy is preserved and new semantic version is identifiable
unproven checkpoint migration is not safe to resume
physical identity requires concentrated masses and springs
operator and excitation identities are separate
Rayleigh and prescribed modal damping are distinct models
modal damping does not fabricate physical reactions
truncation through a modal cluster rejects explicitly
spatial excitation is real and harmonic temporal phasor has explicit real/imag convention
base response frames and full-mass base forcing are declared
corotational stress/tangent findings and rescope guard remain explicit
API additions preserve legacy defaults and keep runtime objects out of model JSON

gate_status.interpretation: WP01 closes the shared-contract portion of G02 and prepares G03/G05. It does not claim implementation-dependent formulation, numerical, runtime non-regression, candidate or publication gates.

deferred_to_implementing_wps: Numerical cluster and residual tolerance values must be preregistered in the relevant method contract before results are observed.
WP03 defines any explicit disjoint legacy/new excitation combine API before implementing it.
WP04 records the selected eigensolver and cluster thresholds before modal benchmark execution.
WP08/WP09 stop and rescope if the stated constitutive/continuum boundary is exceeded.
